title: Fainting
text: Catch the fall safely and lay the person flat, raising the legs slightly.
Loosen tight clothing and let fresh air reach them; most fainting passes within a minute or two.
If they do not wake quickly, treat as unresponsive and get the crew medical officer.
After recovery, sit up slowly; check for injury from the fall and log the episode.
Catch the person and restrain them so they cannot drift; do not raise the legs.
Loosen tight clothing; most fainting passes within a minute or two.
If they do not wake quickly, treat as unresponsive using the in-flight steps and call for the crew medical officer.
After recovery, move slowly and check for injury; log the episode.

citations.title: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) during spaceflight - a guideline for CPR in microgravity from the German Society of Aerospace Medicine (DGLRM) and the European Society of Aerospace Medicine Space Medicine Group (ESAM-SMG)

inflight.note: This variant follows the microgravity guideline; in partial gravity (Moon base, rover) use the Earth steps above.
